animation_description: Seen from BEHIND, walking straight away from the camera with a natural ALTERNATING gait, in place. Legs alternate: first the LEFT leg steps forward while the RIGHT leg pushes back, then the RIGHT leg steps forward while the LEFT leg pushes back; the two legs are never in the same position. Arms swing OPPOSITE to the legs: when the left leg is forward the RIGHT arm swings forward and the LEFT arm swings back, and vice versa. Never swing both arms together, never move both legs together. Back stays facing the camera, shoulders level, subtle vertical bob. HEADLESS body ending at a short neck stump: never draw a head, hair or skull. Same outfit, proportions and pixel scale. No travel across the canvas, no ground shadow.
